Name: Freaky Fellas - Wacky Scarecrows
Author: EspurrQueen
Description:
Do they do anything different from normal scare and rare crows? Nope, except added wackiness to your farmstead. 
Now, where would you find them? Throughout shops around the valley, of course!
Locations:
[code][spoiler]Gregory: In Krobus's shop for 30000 gold
Tablet Beast: At the Desert Trader for 25 diamonds
Bingle Scooter: At the Volcano shop for 10000 gold
Duckzilla: At the Desert Festival Egg Trader for 40 calico eggs  
[/spoiler]
[/code]
Future plans: Add some more freaks? maybe??? And more fun ways to obtain them

Credit to 7thaxis and Team Bog for helping me figure out how Content Patcher works <3
